_description: Fallback Gracenote/TMS station ids for callSigns whose own capture returned no real id (externalListingId echoing ccid, or missing). Harvested by cross-referencing directv2_sample.m3u (which had real ids for these callSigns) against directv3_sample.m3u (which did not). Shared by ah4c_directv_grabber.sh and adbtuner_directv_grabber.sh as a last-resort fallback, keyed on callSign. sdCallSignPairs maps a known SD callSign to its HD counterpart callSign for pairs that do not resolve automatically (neither channelName nor callSign match cleanly) - the SD row is dropped like any other confirmed duplicate.
